issues.suggested_fix: Parse whole tokens instead of matching substrings. Split the text on whitespace; for a Markdown link take only the target after '](' ; strip leading ([<"'` and trailing .,;:!?)]>"'`. A token credits only if it starts with http(s):// or www. (or is a whole source_ref segment). urlsplit it and reject a netloc containing '@' or '%'. The hostname, without the port, must fullmatch [a-z0-9-]+(\.[a-z0-9-]+)+ in ASCII lower case. Then apply the existing host/path table.
